verdict.rationale: Cua Bench's `@evaluate_task` inspects final state and returns rewards, scoring each run the same way whether an oracle, a human or an agent performed it. That gives a per-run success signal that can be compared across runs. Nothing in the evidence shows duration, token or dollar cost being reported, or any run-comparison view. Missing for 10: per-run duration reporting, token/dollar cost reporting, a documented run-comparison dashboard or report, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, per-run metrics (success, duration, token or dollar cost) are reported, so I can compare runs

citations.quote: `@evaluate_task` Inspects the final state and returns rewards. It scores an oracle, a human or an agent the same way.
